body:
S3 sketch posted on STORY-2897 (comment "SKETCH S3 (integration seat, 2026-11-20)"). Two rulings needed before code:
Q1: your brief says keep_merging=false gating, but Joe 10:37 knob trim makes "merging continues while red" FIXED (no keep_merging setting). I propose building NO gate. Say if you want an internal off-by-default gate anyway (~60 lines).
Q2: watch runs in both modes (observational), or review-gated only?
Only one new setting: [landing] red_main.fix_window (default 2h). Cancelled checks: judge_commit_checks folds cancelled into Failed, so the watch gets its own judgement (cancelled-only = unknown); gate behaviour unchanged. Starting BUG-2691 now.
